# Repository collaboration configuration

The [pull request template](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) requires explicit independent approval, current per-directory READMEs, and removal of resolved review reports. [CI](workflows/README.md) performs repository verification, artifact generation, archive/POM inspection, and external packaged-consumer compilation/execution. The [build contract](../project/README.md#local-artifact-packaging) records current workflow identity and local evidence; remote CI and publication remain unconfirmed.
